data.title: USDC On-Chain Transaction Volume Tops $100 Trillion
data.description: USDC’s cumulative on-chain transaction volume has surpassed $100 trillion as of September 12, 2026, according to a post by USDC’s official account on X. According to ChainCatcher, the stablecoin has long been used to support money transfers at internet scale.

data.title: STOCKS | China Life Falls 3% As Hang Seng Index Drops 0.9%
data.description:
China Life Insurance (02628) fell as much as 3.02% to HK$28.86, breaking below its 20-day moving average of HK$29.289, according to ETNet.

The stock last traded at HK$28.90, down 3.02%, after 23.95 million shares changed hands for HK$703 million. The active buy-sell ratio was 42:58, with net active selling of HK$101 million. Hang Seng Index was down 0.9% at 24,703, while the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index fell 0.9% to 8,207.

data.title: STOCKS | Westpac Says Japan's Extra Defense Spending Will Worsen U.S. Treasury Yield Pain
data.description: Westpac Banking Corporation said Japan's possible extra defense spending will deepen pain in the bond market and affect global bonds. According to Sina Finance, Martin Whetton, head of financial markets strategy at the bank, said Federal Reserve rate hikes and persistently higher oil prices will push U.S. Treasury yields higher again, and that the move toward 5% during Monday's trading session should be seen as normal rather than exceptional. The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield rose nearly 3 basis points to 5.01%.

data.title: Japan's Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama Says Government Will Cut Fiscal Waste
data.description: Japan's Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said the government will sharply review and cut redundant subsidies and tax breaks in response to criticism that ministries identified only three possible items for reduction in a voluntary cost-saving review. According to Sina Finance, she said on a Fuji TV program that the government will seek to sharply reduce spending to show that policy is not simply about heavy spending. Katayama also said the government will not issue new debt to fund a consumption tax cut, and that funding will be secured in a way that maintains market confidence. Tax revenue is expected to come in slightly above expectations.

data.title: PTT Seeks More LNG From US Gulf Coast to Broaden Supply Base
data.description:
Thailand’s state-controlled energy company PTT Pcl is in talks to buy more liquefied natural gas from regions including the US Gulf Coast, according to Bloomberg.

The company said the move is aimed at diversifying supplies and expanding its trading business over the next few years.

data.title: Axa CEO Buberl Says Insurer Will Prioritize Organic Growth
data.description:
Axa Chief Executive Officer Thomas Buberl said the insurer will focus on efficiency and shareholder returns rather than acquisitions after raising its profitability and growth targets for the next three years, according to Bloomberg.

Buberl told Bloomberg Television the company will still consider bolt-on deals, but said the main emphasis is organic growth.

data.title: CATL Falls 5% As Battery Capacity Approvals Tighten
data.description:
CATL fell 5% to HK$521.5, with about 2.48 million shares traded for HK$1.319 billion, after touching an intraday high of HK$547.5 and a low of HK$517, according to ETNet.

Mainland media reported that several leading battery makers have confirmed local authorities have largely stopped accepting new filings for power battery and energy storage battery capacity projects since the second half of this year, effectively pausing new capacity applications. Industry estimates show planned energy storage cell expansion has exceeded 800GWh, with total planned capacity approaching 2TWh, far above actual global demand.

ETNet also reported that CATL's acquisition of equity in Chongqing Yaoning New Energy has been approved. The deal is being viewed as a sign of capacity consolidation among leading players as scrutiny of new lithium battery capacity tightens. Public information shows Chongqing Yaoning New Energy was formerly Chihang New Energy, founded in 2021 under the leadership of Geely Technology Group. It is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Jiangsu Yaoning New Energy, whose controlling shareholder is Zhejiang Jiyao Tongxing Energy Technology with an 82.9% stake. Zhejiang Jiyao Tongxing Energy Technology is the industrial operating platform coordinating battery business within Geely Holding, which integrated its battery assets in early 2025.

data.title: Blykalla Signs AI Agreement With Microsoft to Tackle Nuclear Licensing Bottlenecks
data.description: Swedish nuclear technology company Blykalla has signed an agreement with Microsoft to use artificial intelligence to address industry bottlenecks in licensing and authorization, according to Jiemian News. The statement said the collaboration will focus on easing approval-related constraints in the nuclear sector.

data.title: Baidu Autonomous Driving Executive Calls For Hong Kong Compliance Platform
data.description:
Baidu's Hong Kong and Macau autonomous driving general manager Sun Zewei said the biggest barrier to entering each market is the need to meet different legal frameworks and road standards, which requires repeated certification. He suggested Hong Kong should build an international coordination and compliance platform, and described the city as the company's most important strategic foothold, according to ETNet.

He said Baidu had provided more than 23 million public ride services as of June, while cumulative fully driverless autonomous driving mileage reached 240 million km. The company is also conducting related tests at Hong Kong International Airport, Cyberport and Kai Tak.

data.title: Ethiopia Cuts Power Supply to Bitcoin Mining Industry by Three-Quarters
data.description:
Ethiopia has reduced power supply to its Bitcoin-mining industry by three-quarters as the country deals with lower inflows into its hydroelectric dams. According to Bloomberg, the cut affects a crucial part of the industry.

The reduction comes as Ethiopia grapples with reduced inflows into its hydroelectric dams.

data.title: Kelp Temporarily Suspends Address After Suspicious rsETH Activity
data.description:
Kelp said it detected suspicious activity at an address a few hours after it received rsETH. According to Foresight News, the team has imposed a temporary 24-hour suspension on the address, during which rsETH cannot be transferred in or out.

Kelp said its contracts remain secure, rsETH is still fully collateralized, and minting, withdrawals, and integrations are operating normally. The team added that users do not need to take any action.

data.title: XRP Ledger Batch V1.1 Upgrade Is One Vote Short of Activation
data.description:
XRP Ledger’s Batch V1.1 upgrade is one vote short of formal activation. According to Odaily, the upgrade would allow up to eight related transactions to be bundled into a single operation, such as completing a token swap for both parties at the same time.

Of the 35 trusted validators, 27 currently support the proposal, or about 77%. XRP Ledger changes require 80% support, maintained for 14 consecutive days, before they can be activated. RippleX said on Monday that it had fixed 11 additional vulnerabilities involving signatures, authorization checks, and issues that could cause servers to crash. The original Batch proposal had previously been found to allow, under specific conditions, unauthorized inclusion of transactions from another account and was never launched.

data.title: Zimbabwe Ties Single-Currency Shift to Market Conditions
data.description:
Zimbabwe’s move to a single currency will depend on market conditions and macroeconomic stability rather than a fixed timetable, central bank Governor John Mushayavanhu said, according to Bloomberg.

Mushayavanhu said the transition will be driven by those conditions.

data.title: Hong Kong Had More Than 3,380 Single-Family Offices At End-2024, Says Christopher Hui
data.description:
Hong Kong Financial Secretary Christopher Hui said the city had more than 3,380 single-family offices operating in Hong Kong at the end of last year, up about 680 or 25% from two years earlier, according to Ming Pao.

He also said the government had received more than 80 applications since the company re-domiciliation regime took effect, and had approved 50 applications from companies across different industries.

data.title: Airbus Cuts 20-Year China Narrow-Body Delivery Forecast By Nearly 500 Jets
data.description:
Airbus has lowered its forecast for narrow-body aircraft deliveries in China over the next 20 years to 7,480 jets, down by nearly 500 from last year’s estimate, according to Ming Pao.

Francois Cabaret, Airbus head of global market forecasts, said the revision mainly reflects the impact of China’s expanding high-speed rail network. He said the broader effect on the aviation industry should be limited, with only very short-haul traffic gradually shifting away from airlines.

Cabaret added that using aircraft on very short routes is not the best use of airport runway infrastructure. He said some passenger traffic moving to high-speed rail could create synergies with aviation, as travelers may take rail first and then connect to long-haul flights.

data.title: Coupang Forms External Security Advisory Committee After Massive Data Breach
data.description: According to The Korea Herald, Coupang has formed an external information security advisory committee as it works to rebuild public trust and strengthen defenses after last year’s data breach that affected more than 33 million users. The newly launched committee is meant to provide objective reviews of the company’s internal security policies and help improve safeguards for customer information. Coupang said seven outside professionals with expertise in information security, law and management will serve on the committee.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | European Investment Bank Makes €40 Million Finnish Small Modular Reactor Investment
data.description:
The European Investment Bank is investing €40 million ($46 million) in Finnish small modular reactor start-up Steady Energy, according to Bloomberg.

The deal ends the lender’s four-decade break from nuclear financing as Europe pushes to develop new clean energy technologies.

data.title: Goldman, Templeton, Fidelity to Anchor NSE IPO
data.description:
Goldman Sachs Asset Management, Franklin Templeton and Fidelity International Ltd. are among the first global investors set to participate as anchor investors in National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.'s initial public offering, according to Bloomberg.

The exchange is preparing to raise as much as 226 billion rupees ($2.4 billion).

data.title: Ethereum Safe Wallet Attack Drains About $7.73 Million in rsETH
data.description:
A previously unknown Ethereum user’s Safe wallet was attacked, resulting in the loss of about $7.73 million in rsETH. According to Foresight News, Blockaid said the attacker used a public keeper multicall to redirect a custom Uniswap V4 LP Safe module to an attacker-created Hook liquidity pool.

The Hook then unwrapped aEthrsETH into rsETH, which was extracted by Yoink MEV in the same block.

data.title: Attacker Uses Custom Uni V4 LP Safe Module to Drain About $7.73 Million in rsETH
data.description: An attacker used a public keeper multicall to introduce a custom Uni V4 LP Safe module into a hook-based liquidity pool they created, then had the hook unwrap aEthrsETH into rsETH before Yoink MEV completed the extraction within the block. According to Odaily, the two transactions caused about $7.73 million in rsETH losses.
